title: 英作文
description: 和文英訳・自由英作文・要約

compositions.title: 現在完了と経験
compositions.promptJa: 私はこれまでに一度も海外に行ったことがないが、いつかイギリスを訪れてみたい。
modelAnswers: I have never been abroad, but I want to visit the UK someday.
I have never been to a foreign country, but I would like to visit Britain someday.
keyPoints: 経験の否定 have never been abroad / to a foreign country
abroad は副詞（×to abroad）
want to / would like to do
someday（いつか）

compositions.title: 比較と最上級相当表現
compositions.promptJa: 健康ほど大切なものはないと言われるが、そのことに気づくのは病気になってからであることが多い。
modelAnswers: It is said that nothing is more important than health, but we often do not realize this until we get sick.
They say nothing is as important as health, but in many cases we do not realize it until we become ill.
keyPoints: It is said that 〜 / They say 〜
Nothing is more important than 〜（最上級相当）
not 〜 until …「…して初めて〜」
get sick / become ill

compositions.title: 無生物主語を使った英訳
compositions.promptJa: インターネットのおかげで、私たちは世界中の情報に瞬時にアクセスできるようになったが、その情報が正しいかどうかを判断する力がこれまで以上に求められている。
modelAnswers: The Internet has enabled us to access information from all over the world instantly, but we now need the ability to judge whether that information is accurate more than ever before.
Thanks to the Internet, we can now get information from around the world in an instant. However, it is more important than ever to be able to judge whether the information is true.
keyPoints: 無生物主語 The Internet has enabled us to do / Thanks to 〜
access は他動詞（×access to 〜 は名詞用法）
whether 節「〜かどうか」
more than ever (before)「これまで以上に」
information は不可算

compositions.title: 抽象的な内容の英訳（難関大）
compositions.promptJa: 他人の意見に耳を傾けることは、自分の考えを捨てることではない。むしろ、異なる視点に触れることで、自分の考えをより深く理解できるようになるのである。
modelAnswers: Listening to other people's opinions does not mean giving up your own ideas. Rather, being exposed to different perspectives allows you to understand your own thinking more deeply.
To listen to the opinions of others is not to abandon your own views. On the contrary, encountering different points of view helps you understand your own ideas better.
keyPoints: A does not mean B（AはBということではない）
Rather / On the contrary「むしろ」
動名詞主語＋無生物主語構文（allows you to do / helps you do）
perspective / point of view
「理解できるようになる」を自然に表現

usefulExpressions.en: Doing A does not mean doing B.
usefulExpressions.ja: AすることはBすることを意味しない

compositions.title: 制服は必要か
compositions.promptJa: 高校の制服は必要だと思うか。あなたの意見を、理由を2つ挙げて英語で書きなさい。
modelAnswers: I think school uniforms are necessary for high school students. First, uniforms save students time and money. They do not have to think about what to wear every morning, and their parents do not have to buy many clothes. Second, uniforms create a sense of unity. When all students wear the same clothes, they feel that they belong to the same community. For these reasons, I believe high schools should keep uniforms.
keyPoints: 冒頭で賛否を明確に述べている
理由が2つあり、それぞれ具体的に説明されている
First / Second / For these reasons で論理が明確
語数条件（60〜80語）を満たしている
文法・語法の誤りが少ない

compositions.title: オンライン授業と対面授業
compositions.promptJa: 大学の授業は、オンラインで行うのと対面で行うのとでは、どちらが望ましいと考えるか。あなたの考えを理由とともに英語で述べなさい。
modelAnswers: I believe face-to-face classes are better than online classes for university students. First, students can ask questions and discuss ideas with teachers and classmates more easily in a classroom. Such interaction helps them understand difficult topics deeply. Second, attending classes in person helps students make friends and build networks, which can be valuable after graduation. Of course, online classes are convenient because students can study anywhere. However, I think the benefits of learning together in the same place are greater. Therefore, universities should mainly offer face-to-face classes.
keyPoints: 立場の明確さ
理由2つ＋具体的説明
譲歩（Of course 〜. However, …）で反対意見に配慮
語数条件 80〜100語
in person / face-to-face などの適切な語彙

usefulExpressions.ja: もちろん〜だが、しかし…（譲歩）

compositions.title: AI と医療（医学部頻出テーマ）
compositions.promptJa: 近い将来、人工知能（AI）が医師の診断を代替するべきだという意見がある。この意見について、あなたの考えを具体的な理由を挙げて英語で述べなさい。
modelAnswers: I do not think artificial intelligence should replace doctors' diagnoses, although it should play an important supporting role. Admittedly, AI can analyze huge amounts of medical data far faster than humans, and some systems already detect certain diseases in X-ray images with high accuracy. Using such tools could reduce doctors' workloads and prevent oversights. However, diagnosis is not simply a matter of identifying a disease. Doctors must consider each patient's background, values, and feelings, and explain the situation in a way the patient can accept. Moreover, when an AI system makes a mistake, it is unclear who should take responsibility. For these reasons, the final decision should remain with human doctors, who can combine the results of AI analysis with careful communication. AI should be a powerful assistant, not a replacement.
keyPoints: 主張の明確さ（代替すべきでない／すべき）
譲歩（Admittedly 〜. However, …）で多面的に論じている
医療特有の観点（患者との対話・責任の所在・データ処理能力）
語数条件 120〜150語
抽象語（diagnosis, responsibility, accuracy）の正確な使用

usefulExpressions.ja: 補助的な役割を果たす

usefulExpressions.en: not A but B / A, not B

compositions.title: 要約：睡眠と記憶
compositions.promptJa:
次の内容を英語40〜50語で要約しなさい。
「睡眠は単なる休息ではない。研究によれば、眠っている間に脳はその日に学んだ情報を整理し、重要なものを長期記憶として定着させる。そのため、試験前に徹夜するよりも、十分な睡眠をとる方が学習の効果は高い。」
modelAnswers: Sleep is more than rest. Research shows that during sleep the brain organizes the information learned that day and turns important parts into long-term memories. Therefore, getting enough sleep is more effective for learning than staying up all night before an exam.
keyPoints: 主旨（睡眠は記憶の定着に重要）を含む
具体例・根拠を簡潔に
結論（徹夜より睡眠）
語数条件
原文の直訳ではなく言い換え

compositions.title: 和文英訳：知識と理解
compositions.promptJa: 情報があふれる現代では、何かを知っていることそれ自体の価値は相対的に低くなった。むしろ問われているのは、得た知識を互いに結びつけ、まだ誰も答えを持たない問いに向き合う力である。
modelAnswers: In today's world, which is flooded with information, simply knowing something has become relatively less valuable. What is required instead is the ability to connect the pieces of knowledge we have acquired and to face questions that no one has yet answered.

Now that we are surrounded by an overwhelming amount of information, the value of merely knowing something has declined in relative terms. Rather, what we are being tested on is our ability to link what we have learned and to confront questions to which nobody yet has an answer.
keyPoints: 「情報があふれる」flooded with / overwhelmed by information
「〜それ自体の価値」the value of merely knowing / simply knowing
「相対的に低くなった」has become relatively less valuable / has declined in relative terms
「むしろ問われているのは」What is required instead / Rather, what matters is
「まだ誰も答えを持たない問い」questions that no one has yet answered

compositions.title: 和文英訳：医療と対話（医学部）
compositions.promptJa: 医師にとって最も難しいのは、病名を告げることではなく、その知らせを受け止めた患者とともに、これからどう生きていくかを考えることなのかもしれない。
modelAnswers: Perhaps the most difficult thing for a doctor is not telling patients the name of their illness but thinking together with them, after they have accepted the news, about how they will live from then on.

What doctors find hardest may not be informing patients of their diagnosis, but working with those patients, once they have come to terms with the news, to consider how they are going to live their lives from now on.
keyPoints: not A but B の構文で「〜ではなく…」
「病名を告げる」tell patients the name of their illness / inform patients of their diagnosis
「知らせを受け止めた」accept the news / come to terms with the news
「これからどう生きていくか」how they will live from now on（間接疑問）
「〜なのかもしれない」Perhaps / may（ヘッジ）

compositions.title: 和文英訳：異文化理解
compositions.promptJa: 外国語を学ぶ意義は、単に別の言葉で同じことが言えるようになることにあるのではない。自分が当たり前だと思っていたものの見方が、数ある見方の一つにすぎないと気づくことにこそある。
modelAnswers: The significance of learning a foreign language does not lie simply in becoming able to say the same things in different words. It lies, rather, in realizing that the way of seeing things you have taken for granted is only one of many possible perspectives.

Learning a foreign language is meaningful not merely because it enables us to express the same ideas in another language, but because it makes us aware that the view of the world we have always assumed to be natural is just one among many.
keyPoints: 「〜にあるのではない…にこそある」lie not in A but in B / not merely because A but because B
「当たり前だと思っていた」take 〜 for granted / assume 〜 to be natural
「数ある見方の一つにすぎない」only one of many perspectives
「気づく」realize / become aware

compositions.title: 自由英作文：延命治療と生活の質
compositions.promptJa: 医療技術の進歩により、以前なら助からなかった患者の命を長く保つことが可能になった。一方で、延命よりも生活の質（quality of life）を重視すべきだという意見もある。あなたの考えを、具体的な理由を挙げて英語で述べなさい。
modelAnswers: In my view, medical decisions near the end of life should give priority to the patient's quality of life, as long as that choice reflects the patient's own wishes. Admittedly, extending life is one of the fundamental goals of medicine, and it would be dangerous to assume that a life with illness is less worth living. However, prolonging life by every available means can sometimes cause great physical pain and leave patients unable to communicate with their families. In such cases, additional weeks of life may mean more suffering rather than more meaningful time. More importantly, it is the patient, not the doctor or the family, who should decide what makes life worth living. For this reason, doctors need to talk with patients early, explain the options honestly, and respect their values even when they choose not to receive aggressive treatment. In conclusion, the aim of medicine should not be simply to make life longer, but to help each patient live the remaining time in the way he or she chooses.
keyPoints: 立場の明確さ（どちらを重視するか、条件付きか）
譲歩（Admittedly, 〜. However, …）で反対意見を認めた上で論じている
具体的な理由（苦痛・意思疎通・患者の価値観）
患者の自己決定（autonomy）・インフォームド・コンセントなど医療倫理の観点
語数 150〜180 語、結論で主張を言い換えている

usefulExpressions.ja: 何が人生を生きる価値のあるものにするか
患者の自己決定を尊重する

compositions.title: 自由英作文：科学研究の自由と責任
compositions.promptJa: 「科学者は、自らの研究が社会に悪用される可能性について責任を負うべきだ」という意見について、あなたの考えを英語で述べなさい。
modelAnswers: I partly agree with this statement. Scientists cannot be expected to foresee every possible misuse of their work, because almost any discovery can be used for harmful purposes. Chemistry gave us both medicines and poisons, and the internet supports education as well as crime. If researchers were held responsible for all such outcomes, many might avoid valuable lines of inquiry altogether. On the other hand, scientists are often the people who best understand the risks of new technologies, such as gene editing or artificial intelligence. They therefore have a duty to share those risks openly and to take part in public discussions about how their work should be regulated. In short, scientists should not bear the entire responsibility for misuse, but they should accept responsibility for warning society and helping it make informed decisions.
keyPoints: 部分的賛成など、立場を明確に示している
両面（責任を負わせることの問題点／科学者の専門性に伴う責任）を論じている
具体例（化学・インターネット・遺伝子編集・AI）
On the other hand / therefore / In short による論理展開

usefulExpressions.ja: 十分な情報に基づいて判断する

compositions.title: 要約：専門家と市民
compositions.promptJa:
次の内容を英語60〜80語で要約しなさい。
「現代社会の重要な決定の多くは、気候変動や感染症対策のように、高度な専門知識を必要とする。そのため、専門家に判断を任せるべきだという考えには一定の説得力がある。しかし、どのリスクをどこまで受け入れるかという判断は、科学だけでは決まらない価値の問題を含んでいる。専門家の役割は、市民に代わって決めることではなく、市民が判断するために必要な情報を、不確実性も含めて正直に伝えることである。」
modelAnswers: Many important decisions today, such as those on climate change or infectious diseases, require specialist knowledge, so leaving them to experts seems reasonable. However, deciding which risks to accept involves values that science alone cannot settle. Therefore, experts should not make decisions on behalf of citizens; instead, they should honestly provide the information, including its uncertainties, that citizens need in order to judge for themselves.
keyPoints: 前提（専門知識が必要→専門家に任せる考えに説得力）
転換（リスクの受容は価値の問題で科学だけでは決まらない）
結論（専門家の役割＝不確実性も含めた情報提供）
However / Therefore で論理の流れを示す
原文の直訳でなく言い換え、語数 60〜80 語

compositions.title: 和文英訳：不定詞と目的
compositions.promptJa: 私は将来、困っている人を助けるために医者になりたい。
modelAnswers: I want to become a doctor in the future to help people in need.
In the future, I would like to be a doctor so that I can help people who are in trouble.
keyPoints: want to / would like to + 動詞の原形
become (be) a doctor（a を忘れない）
目的の不定詞 to help ... / so that I can help ...
「困っている人」people in need / people who are in trouble

compositions.title: 和文英訳：比較
compositions.promptJa: 私にとって、数学は英語よりも難しいが、ずっとおもしろい。
modelAnswers: For me, math is more difficult than English, but it is much more interesting.
Math is harder than English for me, but it is far more interesting.
keyPoints: 比較級 more difficult / harder than
比較級の強調 much / far（very は不可）
「私にとって」for me
but で対比をつなぐ

compositions.title: 自由英作文：好きな季節
compositions.promptJa: あなたが一番好きな季節は何ですか。その理由を含めて英語で書きなさい。
modelAnswers: My favorite season is autumn. First, the weather is cool and comfortable, so I can enjoy walking. Second, there are many delicious foods, such as sweet potatoes and chestnuts.
keyPoints: 最初の文で質問に答えている
理由を2つ（First / Second）
such as で具体例を挙げている
三人称単数・複数形の誤りがない

compositions.title: 和文英訳：関係代名詞
compositions.promptJa: 昨日駅で会った女性は、私の母が若い頃に教えていた生徒だった。
modelAnswers: The woman I met at the station yesterday was a student whom my mother had taught when she was young.
The woman who I saw at the station yesterday turned out to be one of the students my mother taught when she was young.
keyPoints: 関係代名詞（目的格は省略可）The woman (who/whom) I met
時制：母が教えていたのは「会った」より前 → had taught（過去形でも可）
when she was young
主語が長くても動詞 was を見失わない

compositions.title: 和文英訳：動名詞と現在完了
compositions.promptJa: 毎朝早く起きることは簡単ではないが、私はこの3か月間ずっと続けている。
modelAnswers: Getting up early every morning is not easy, but I have kept doing it for the past three months.
It is not easy to get up early every morning, but I have been doing it for three months.
keyPoints: 動名詞主語 Getting up ... / 形式主語 It is ... to ...
現在完了（継続）have kept doing / have been doing
for the past three months
it / so で前の内容を受ける

compositions.title: 自由英作文：部活動は必要か
compositions.promptJa: 高校生は部活動に参加すべきだと思いますか。あなたの考えを理由とともに英語で書きなさい。
modelAnswers: I think high school students should join a club. First, they can make friends with students from other classes and grades. Second, they can learn how to work as a team and keep trying even when things are hard. These experiences will be useful in the future.
keyPoints: 賛否を最初に明示（I think ... should ...）
理由2つと具体的な説明
最後に結論・まとめの1文
語数条件 40〜60 語

usefulExpressions.ja: チームとして協力する

compositions.title: 和文英訳：形式主語と仮定法
compositions.promptJa: もしスマートフォンがなかったら、私たちの生活はずっと不便だろう。しかし、それに頼りすぎるのは危険だ。
modelAnswers: If it were not for smartphones, our lives would be much less convenient. However, it is dangerous to depend on them too much.
Without smartphones, our lives would be far more inconvenient. It is risky, however, to rely too heavily on them.
keyPoints: 仮定法過去 If it were not for / Without ..., ... would ...
比較級の強調 much / far
形式主語 it is dangerous to do
depend on / rely on ... too much

compositions.title: 自由英作文：一人旅と団体旅行
compositions.promptJa: 旅行をするなら、一人旅と友人との旅行のどちらがよいと思いますか。理由を2つ挙げて英語で書きなさい。
modelAnswers: I prefer traveling with friends to traveling alone. First, it is safer. If one of us gets sick or loses something, the others can help. Second, sharing experiences makes them more enjoyable. When we see a beautiful view or eat local food together, we can talk about it and create memories that we will remember for a long time. For these reasons, I would choose to travel with my friends.
keyPoints: prefer A to B で立場を明示
理由2つ（安全・経験の共有）とその具体化
結論で主張を繰り返している
語数条件 60〜80 語

compositions.title: 図表描写：高校生の平均睡眠時間
compositions.promptJa:
次のデータは、ある高校の生徒の平日の平均睡眠時間の推移を示している。データから読み取れることを説明し、その原因として考えられることを1つ挙げて英語で書きなさい。
【データ】2015年：7.2時間　2020年：6.6時間　2025年：6.1時間
modelAnswers: The data shows that the average sleeping time of students at the school on weekdays has decreased steadily, from 7.2 hours in 2015 to 6.1 hours in 2025. This means students now sleep more than one hour less than ten years ago. One possible reason is that more students use smartphones late at night, which keeps them awake.
keyPoints: 傾向（減少）を正確に述べる decrease steadily / fall from A to B
具体的な数値の引用
変化量の言い換え（1時間以上少ない）
原因を推測として示す One possible reason is that ...
語数条件 50〜70 語

usefulExpressions.en: decrease steadily from A to B
usefulExpressions.ja: AからBへ着実に減少する
考えられる理由の一つは〜だ
データは〜を示している

compositions.title: 和文英訳：強調構文と分詞構文
compositions.promptJa: 留学して初めて、私は自分がいかに日本の文化について知らなかったかに気づいた。
modelAnswers: It was not until I studied abroad that I realized how little I knew about Japanese culture.
Only after I went abroad to study did I realize how little I knew about the culture of Japan.
keyPoints: 「〜して初めて」It was not until ... that ... / Only after ... did I ...
「いかに知らなかったか」how little I knew（間接疑問）
時制の一致（knew）
study abroad（abroad は副詞）

usefulExpressions.ja: Sがいかに知らなかったか

compositions.title: 図表描写：通学手段の変化
compositions.promptJa:
次の表は、ある町の中学生の通学手段の割合を示している。表から読み取れる変化を説明し、その変化についてのあなたの意見を英語で書きなさい。
【表】徒歩：2005年 60% → 2025年 40%　／　自転車：2005年 30% → 2025年 25%　／　車での送迎：2005年 10% → 2025年 35%
modelAnswers: The table shows how junior high school students in a town got to school in 2005 and 2025. The percentage of students who walked dropped from 60% to 40%, while those driven by car rose sharply from 10% to 35%. Cycling decreased slightly. In my opinion, this change is not desirable. Walking to school is good exercise, and it gives children chances to talk with friends. Parents should drive their children only when it is truly necessary.
keyPoints: 表の内容の要約（何のデータか）
最も大きな変化（車送迎の増加・徒歩の減少）を数値で示す
while で対比
意見を In my opinion で明示し、理由を添える
語数条件 70〜90 語

usefulExpressions.en: rise sharply from A to B

compositions.title: 和文英訳：抽象名詞と無生物主語
compositions.promptJa: 便利な道具が増えたことで、私たちは自分で考える機会を失いつつあるのではないだろうか。
modelAnswers: I wonder if the increase in convenient tools is depriving us of opportunities to think for ourselves.
Isn't it possible that, as convenient devices have become more common, we are losing chances to think on our own?
keyPoints: 「〜ではないだろうか」I wonder if ... / Isn't it possible that ...?
無生物主語 the increase in ... deprives us of ...
「失いつつある」進行形 is depriving / are losing
think for ourselves / on our own

compositions.title: 和文英訳：譲歩と主張
compositions.promptJa: 失敗を恐れる気持ちは誰にでもある。だが、その気持ちに負けて挑戦をやめてしまえば、成長の機会も同時に失うことになる。
modelAnswers: Everyone is afraid of failure to some extent. However, if you give in to that fear and stop trying, you will lose the chance to grow at the same time.
It is natural for anyone to fear failure, but if we let that fear stop us from taking on challenges, we also lose opportunities to grow.
keyPoints: 「誰にでもある」Everyone ... / It is natural for anyone to ...
「その気持ちに負けて」give in to that fear / let the fear stop us
条件 if 節（現在形）
「同時に失う」lose ... at the same time / also lose

compositions.title: 自由英作文：18歳からの選挙権
compositions.promptJa: 日本では18歳から選挙で投票できる。若者の投票率を上げるためにはどうすればよいか、あなたの考えを具体的に英語で述べなさい。
modelAnswers: I believe that two changes would encourage more young people to vote. First, schools should teach politics in a more practical way. Many students know how elections work but do not understand how political decisions affect their own lives, such as university fees or job opportunities. If they learned about such connections, they would feel that voting matters. Second, voting should be made easier. Allowing people to vote online, for example, would help students who live away from home or who are busy with part-time jobs. Of course, online voting must be secure. However, if these steps were taken, I am sure that young people would participate more actively in elections.
keyPoints: 提案を最初に明示（two changes）
具体的な提案2つ（教育・投票方法）と効果
具体例（学費・オンライン投票）
譲歩（Of course ... However ...）で懸念に対応
仮定法 would で提案の効果を述べている

compositions.title: 和文英訳：比較の慣用表現
compositions.promptJa: 大切なのは、どれだけ多くの本を読んだかではなく、一冊の本からどれだけ深く考えたかである。
modelAnswers: What matters is not how many books you have read but how deeply you have thought about each one.
It is not the number of books you read but the depth of thought you gain from a single book that really counts.
keyPoints: What matters is not A but B / It is not A but B that counts
how many books / how deeply（間接疑問の並列）
「一冊の本から」each one / a single book
名詞化 the number of ... / the depth of ...

compositions.title: 要約：テクノロジーと孤独
compositions.promptJa:
次の内容を英語50〜70語で要約しなさい。
「SNSのおかげで、私たちはかつてないほど多くの人とつながっている。それにもかかわらず、孤独を感じる人は減っていない。その一因は、オンラインでのやりとりが、他人の成功ばかりを目にさせ、自分と比べて落ち込む機会を増やしていることにあると考えられる。大切なのは、つながりの数ではなく、本音を話せる関係の質である。」
modelAnswers: Although social media connects us with more people than ever, loneliness has not decreased. One reason may be that online interaction mainly shows us other people's successes, which leads us to compare ourselves with them and feel worse. Therefore, what matters is not how many connections we have but the quality of relationships in which we can speak honestly.
keyPoints: 逆接（つながっているのに孤独は減らない）
原因（他人の成功を見て比較し落ち込む）
結論（数ではなく質）
Although / Therefore による論理の明示
